source_en: Would you like to use the original Americas map, or\na map prepared with the map editor?
zh_hant: 您想使用原版的美洲地圖，還是用地圖編輯器製作的地圖？

source_en:
^^Warning!
^
The Revolution does not function in multi-player mode.  If
you declare independence, the game will become a single player
game.  Are you sure you want to do this?

Declare independence
Never Mind
zh_hant:
^^警告！
^
革命在多人模式下無法進行。若您宣布獨立，遊戲將轉為單人模式進行。您確定要這麼做嗎？

宣布獨立
算了

source_en: %STRING0 does not match the current map\nsize.  It cannot be loaded at this time.
zh_hant: %STRING0與目前地圖尺寸不符，此時無法載入。

source_en:
^^Year of Our Lord
^^1492
^
^^An Audience With
^^The King of %COUNTRY
^
"For the greater glory of %COUNTRY,
we dub thee Viceroy of the New World.
Go and explore this new land. Settle
it and bring wealth and glory to
yourself and our nation."
zh_hant:
^^主後
^^1492年
^
^^覲見
^^%COUNTRY國王
^
「為了%COUNTRY更崇高的榮耀，朕冊封你為新世界的副王。去探索這片新大陸，開拓殖民領地，為你自己與我們的國家帶來財富與榮耀。」
notes: 目標159；Viceroy依既有難度稱號譯稿定為「副王」（與總督／Governor區分）；%COUNTRY為國名代入的變數，未見於控制碼清單但比照%STRING/%NUMBER原樣保留。

source_en:
^^Year of Our Lord
^^1492
^
^^An Audience With
^^The Stadtholder
^
"For the greater glory of %COUNTRY,
we dub thee Viceroy of the New World.
Go and explore this new land. Settle
it and bring wealth and glory to
yourself and our nation."
zh_hant:
^^主後
^^1492年
^
^^覲見
^^執政
^
「為了%COUNTRY更崇高的榮耀，朕冊封你為新世界的副王。去探索這片新大陸，開拓殖民領地，為你自己與我們的國家帶來財富與榮耀。」
notes: 目標159；Stadtholder為荷蘭共和國元首頭銜，術語表未收錄，依史實慣譯「執政」；Viceroy比照@VICEROY譯為「副王」。

source_en: Land Ho!  What shall we call this new\nland, Your Excellency?
zh_hant: 發現陸地了！閣下，這片新大陸該如何命名呢？

source_en:
Shall we make landfall, Your Excellency,
and leave the ships behind?

Stay With Ships
Make Landfall
zh_hant:
閣下，我們要不要登陸，把船留在原地？

留在船上
登陸

source_en:
Our ships cannot navigate up this river,
Excellency.  Shall we make landfall
and leave the ships behind?

Stay With Ships
Make Landfall
zh_hant:
閣下，我們的船無法沿這條河流航行。要不要登陸，把船留在原地？

留在船上
登陸

source_en: That function can be performed only\nby {pioneers}.
zh_hant: 這項作業只能由{前鋒}執行。

source_en: That function can be performed only\nby {colonists}.
zh_hant: 這項作業只能由{殖民地居民}執行。

source_en: Only {Privateers} and {Frigates} can attack enemy ships.
zh_hant: 只有{私掠船}和{快速艦}能攻擊敵方船隻。

source_en: Land units cannot enter an enemy occupied square\nfrom on board a ship.  You must first unload them\ninto an empty or friendly-occupied square.
zh_hant: 陸上單位無法從船上直接進入敵方佔領的方格，必須先將他們卸載到空地或我方佔領的方格。

source_en: It may surprise you to learn that colonies\ncannot be built at sea.
zh_hant: 您可能會驚訝地發現，殖民領地無法建在海上。

source_en:
This square does not have access to the {ocean},
Your Excellency.  If we build a {colony} here we
must transport its produce to {port}
using {wagon trains}, which we can build in any
colony.

"Oh, I forgot about that."
"And that is exactly what I had in mind."
zh_hant:
閣下，這個方格無法通往{海洋}。若在此建立{殖民領地}，就必須把產物運到{港口}，而這得靠{貨車}——貨車可以在任何殖民領地建造。

「喔，我倒是忘了這一點。」
「這正是我原本的打算。」

source_en:
The colony of {%STRING0} is {far too crowded},
Excellency.
We had best find another colony for these
immigrants.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地{過度擁擠}，我們最好替這些移民找另一座殖民領地。

source_en: We must build a {college} to teach that\nprofession ({%STRING0}) in our colony.
zh_hant: 我們必須在殖民領地建造{學院}，才能傳授該項專長（{%STRING0}）。

source_en: We must build a {university} to teach that\nprofession ({%STRING0}) in our colony.
zh_hant: 我們必須在殖民領地建造{大學}，才能傳授該項專長（{%STRING0}）。

source_en:
We have a {teacher} in {%STRING0}, but all the colonists
there already have specialty professions.  Perhaps
you should clear the specialty of one of the colonists
by selecting him on the colony screen and picking
"{Clear Specialty}" from the Jobs menu.
zh_hant: 我們的{老師}已在{%STRING0}任教，但當地殖民地居民都已經有專長了。您或許可以在殖民領地畫面選取其中一位，從工作選單選擇「{清除專長}」，取消他的專長。

source_en: A {criminal} in {%STRING0} has become an {indentured\nservant} through education.
zh_hant: {輕刑罪犯}在{%STRING0}已經透過教育成為{僕役}。

source_en: An {indentured servant} in {%STRING0} has become a\n{free colonist} through education.
zh_hant: {僕役}在{%STRING0}已經透過教育成為{自由移民}。

source_en: This colony is under {siege}, since enemy combat units\noutnumber friendly combat units in the area.  Until the siege is\nlifted, only Soldier and Dragoon units can be created here.
zh_hant: 這座殖民領地正遭到{圍城}，因為當地的敵方戰鬥單位數量超過我方。圍城解除前，這裡只能建造士兵和龍騎兵單位。
notes: 目標159；siege（圍城）與abandon（放棄）皆非terms.zh-Hant.tsv收錄詞，依上下文直譯常見軍事用語。

source_en:
Shall we indeed {abandon} our %STRING0 colony,
Your Excellency, forfeiting all of our hard work
here?

Yes, it is God's will.
Never! That would be folly.
zh_hant:
閣下，我們真的要{放棄}%STRING0殖民領地，捨棄我們在此的一切心血嗎？

是的，這是上帝的旨意。
絕不！那太愚蠢了。

source_en:
Shall we indeed {abandon} our %STRING0 colony,
Your Excellency, forfeiting all of our hard work
here?  If we have no colonies at all after 1600,
the King may revoke our charter!

Yes, it is God's will.
Never! That would be folly.
zh_hant:
閣下，我們真的要{放棄}%STRING0殖民領地，捨棄我們在此的一切心血嗎？若1600年後我們一座殖民領地都沒有，國王可能會撤銷我們的特許狀！

是的，這是上帝的旨意。
絕不！那太愚蠢了。

source_en:
We have reached the {high seas}, Your
Excellency.  Shall we sail for
Europe?

Yes, steady as she goes.
No, let us remain in these waters.
zh_hant:
閣下，我們已經抵達{公海}。要不要啟航前往歐洲？

是，穩住航向前進。
不，留在這片海域。

source_en:
Shall we set sail for the {New World},
Your Excellency?

Yes, steady as she goes.
No, let us remain in port.
zh_hant:
閣下，我們要啟航前往{新世界}嗎？

是，穩住航向前進。
不，留在港口。

source_en: Religious unrest in %COUNTRY causes increased\nemigration.  Colonists ({%STRING1}) now available in %STRING0.
zh_hant: %COUNTRY的宗教動盪導致移民人數增加。現有殖民地居民（{%STRING1}）已抵達%STRING0。

source_en:
The following individuals will
accompany us to the New World if we will
pay their passage ({%NUMBER0 gold}).  Whom
shall we recruit?
zh_hant: 只要支付船費（{%NUMBER0金幣}），以下人選就願意隨我們前往新世界。要招募哪一位？

source_en:
Religious unrest in %COUNTRY causes increased
emigration.  Colonists now available in %STRING0.
The following individuals will
accompany us to the New World to
pursue religious freedom.  Whom shall we recruit?
zh_hant: %COUNTRY的宗教動盪導致移民人數增加，%STRING0現有殖民地居民可供招募。以下人選願意隨我們前往新世界追求信仰自由。要招募哪一位？

source_en: The following specialty professions are available\namong the %STRING0. Which shall we recruit?
zh_hant: %STRING0目前有以下專長人選可供招募，要招募哪一位？

source_en: The {Royal University} can provide us with specialists\nif we grease the right palms.  Which\nskill shall we request?
zh_hant: 只要打點得宜，{皇家大學}就能為我們提供專家。要指定哪一項技能？
notes: 目標159；Royal University非terms.zh-Hant.tsv中的University建築，是歐洲畫面另一花錢招募專家的虛構機制名稱，比照Royal Expeditionary Force的「皇家」譯法；grease the right palms（賄賂）意譯為「打點得宜」。

source_en: The following items are available.  Which shall\nwe purchase?
zh_hant: 以下品項可供購買，要買哪一項？

source_en: The {Schoolhouse} can support a faculty of only {one}\nteacher at a time, Your Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，{學校}一次只能容納{一}位教師任教。

source_en: The {College} can support a faculty of only {two}\nteachers at a time, Your Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，{學院}一次只能容納{兩}位教師任教。

source_en: The {University} can support a faculty of only {three}\nteachers at a time, Your Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，{大學}一次只能容納{三}位教師任教。

source_en: We cannot operate fishing boats at this colony\nuntil we build {Docks}, Your Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，這座殖民領地必須先建造{碼頭}，才能派出漁船作業。

source_en: A new cargo of {%STRING1} is ready at {%STRING0}, Your Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，一批新的{%STRING1}已經在{%STRING0}備妥。

source_en: A new cargo of {%STRING1} is ready at {%STRING0}, Your Excellency.\n%STRING0 has reached its storage capacity for %STRING1 ({%NUMBER0}), so\nwe may wish to consider building a larger {warehouse} there.
zh_hant: 閣下，一批新的{%STRING1}已經在{%STRING0}備妥。\n%STRING0的%STRING1庫存已經達到上限（{%NUMBER0}），\n或許該考慮在當地建造更大的{倉庫}。

source_en: A new cargo of {%STRING1} is ready at {%STRING0}, Your Excellency.\n%STRING0 has reached its storage capacity for %STRING1 ({%NUMBER0}).
zh_hant: 閣下，一批新的{%STRING1}已經在{%STRING0}備妥。\n%STRING0的%STRING1庫存已經達到上限（{%NUMBER0}）。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {lumber}, Your Excellency.  Our carpenters\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{木材}已經用盡，木匠們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {cotton}, Your Excellency.  Our weavers\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{棉花}已經用盡，織布工們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {tobacco}, Your Excellency.  Our tobacconists\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{煙草}已經用盡，煙草商們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {sugar}, Your Excellency.  Our distillers\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{蔗糖}已經用盡，釀酒人們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {furs}, Your Excellency.  Our fur traders\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{毛皮}已經用盡，毛皮商人們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {ore}, Your Excellency.  Our blacksmiths\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{礦石}已經用盡，鐵匠們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: {%STRING0} has run out of {tools}, Your Excellency.  Our gunsmiths\ncannot continue their work until a new supply is found.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的{工具}已經用盡，槍匠們只能等到補充新貨才能繼續工作。

source_en: Food stores have been depleted\nin {%STRING0}, Your Excellency!
zh_hant: 閣下！{%STRING0}的食物儲備已經耗盡！

source_en: Food stores have been depleted\nin {%STRING0}, Your Excellency!  {Winter} is coming soon and\nwe may {starve} to death!
zh_hant: 閣下！{%STRING0}的食物儲備已經耗盡！{冬天}即將來臨，我們恐怕會活活{餓死}！

source_en: Your Excellency!  Our colony at {%STRING0} has\nvanished!  The colonists appear\nto have {starved} to death.
zh_hant: 閣下！我們位於{%STRING0}的殖民領地已經消失了！殖民地居民似乎已經活活{餓死}。

source_en: {%STRING0} colony has run out of food, Your Excellency!\nIn this harsh winter weather, many colonists are {starving}\nto death.
zh_hant: 閣下！{%STRING0}殖民領地的食物已經用盡！在這嚴酷的冬季天候中，許多殖民地居民正在活活{餓死}。

source_en: {%STRING0} colony has run out of food, Your Excellency!\nColonists are {starving} to death, and to make matters worse,\nwinter is coming soon.
zh_hant: 閣下！{%STRING0}殖民領地的食物已經用盡！殖民地居民正在活活{餓死}，更糟的是，冬天即將來臨。

source_en: The colony of {%STRING0} is rapidly depleting its\nfood supply, Your Excellency.  We have only {%NUMBER0 food}\nleft.  We must have food for the winter months.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地的糧食正在迅速枯竭，我們只剩下{%NUMBER0單位食物}，必須儲備糧食以度過冬季。

source_en: The colony of {%STRING0} has exceeded its warehouse capacity.\n{%NUMBER0} tons of {%STRING1} have been thrown away.\nA larger {warehouse} could hold another {100} tons of this cargo.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地已經超過倉庫容量。{%NUMBER0}噸的{%STRING1}被丟棄了。更大的{倉庫}可以多容納{100}噸這類貨物。

source_en: The colony of {%STRING0} has exceeded its warehouse capacity.\nSome of our cargo has been thrown away.\nA larger {warehouse} could hold another {100} tons of this cargo.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地已經超過倉庫容量。部分貨物已經被丟棄。更大的{倉庫}可以多容納{100}噸這類貨物。

source_en: The colony of {%STRING0} has exceeded its warehouse capacity.\n{%NUMBER0} tons of {%STRING1} have been thrown away.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地已經超過倉庫容量。{%NUMBER0}噸的{%STRING1}被丟棄了。

source_en: The colony of {%STRING0} has exceeded its warehouse capacity.\nSome of our cargo has been thrown away.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}殖民領地已經超過倉庫容量。部分貨物已經被丟棄。

完成%STRING0需要花費%NUMBER0$。
^國庫：%NUMBER1$。

算了。
立即完成。

source_en: Which of the following individuals shall we recruit?
zh_hant: 我們該招募下列哪一位人選？

source_en: You have discovered a {Fountain\nof Youth}!  Rumors fly in Europe! Immigrants line\nthe docks to seek perpetual youth in the New World!
zh_hant: 您發現了{青春之泉}！消息傳回歐洲後掀起熱潮，移民們紛紛湧向碼頭，只為了到新世界追求長生不老！
notes: 目標159；不換：Rumors fly 指消息傳開

source_en:
You have found one of the {Seven
Cities of Cibola}!  Treasure worth {%NUMBER1$} unearthed
in the ruins!  It will take a {Galleon} to get this
treasure back to Europe!
zh_hant: 您找到了傳說中的{錫伯拉七城}之一！廢墟中挖出價值{%NUMBER1$}的寶藏！得靠一艘{帆船}才能把這批寶藏運回歐洲！
notes: 目標159；Cibola（錫伯拉七城）沿用glossary.zh-Hant.tsv候選音譯「錫伯拉」，terms.zh-Hant.tsv未收錄此詞，屬非定稿譯名，待覆核。

source_en: You find the ruins of a lost civilization.\nWithin are gold and artifacts worth {%NUMBER0$}.
zh_hant: 您發現了一座失落文明的遺跡，裡頭有價值{%NUMBER0$}的黃金與文物。

source_en:
Your expedition happens upon strange burial
mounds.

"Let us search for treasure!"
"Stay clear of those!"
zh_hant:
探險隊遇上了一片奇特的墓地。

「讓我們搜尋寶藏！」
「離那些東西遠一點！」
notes: 目標159；burial mounds 簡化譯為「墓地」，未強調土丘意象，避免使用生僻字「塚」。

source_en:
These are the burial grounds of our
ancient {%STRING0} fathers!  You have
trespassed on sacred land.  Now
you must die!
zh_hant: 「這裡是我們{%STRING0}祖先安息的聖地！你們竟敢褻瀆此地，如今都難逃一死！」

source_en: The mounds are cold and empty.
zh_hant: 墓地裡冰冷而空蕩，什麼也沒有。
裡頭找到了一些價值{%NUMBER0$}的小飾品。

source_en: Within, you find incredible treasure worth {%NUMBER1$}!\nIt will take a {Galleon} to get this treasure back\nto Europe!
zh_hant: 裡頭找到了價值{%NUMBER1$}的驚人寶藏！得靠一艘{帆船}才能把這批寶藏運回歐洲！

source_en: Your expedition has vanished without\na trace!
zh_hant: 探險隊已經消失得無影無蹤！
您什麼也沒找到，只有一堆謠言。

source_en: Your expedition enters the village of a small,\nfriendly tribe.  The chief offers you a gift\nof {%NUMBER0$}.
zh_hant: 探險隊進入了一個弱小、友善部落的村莊。酋長贈送您價值{%NUMBER0$}的禮物。

source_en: You are trespassing near our holy {%STRING0} shrines!  The\n%STRING0 tribe is most displeased!
zh_hant: 「你們正逼近我們{%STRING0}的聖地！%STRING0部落對此非常不悅！」

source_en: You happen upon the desperate survivors of\na former colony.  In exchange for badly needed\nsupplies, they swear allegiance to %STRING0.
zh_hant: 您遇見了一群走投無路的舊殖民領地倖存者。為了換取急需的補給，他們向%STRING0宣誓效忠。

source_en: The {%STRING0} and {%STRING1} have signed a peace treaty.
The {%STRING0} and {%STRING1} are now at war.

We have signed a peace treaty with the {%STRING0},
Your Excellency.

Cancel Action.
Break Treaty.
zh_hant:
「我們已經與{%STRING0}簽署了和平條約，閣下。」

取消動作。
撕毀條約。

source_en:
Shall we attack the {%STRING0}, Your Excellency?

Yes
No
zh_hant:
閣下，我們要攻擊{%STRING0}嗎？

是
否

source_en: Your expedition has reached a %STRING0 of {%STRING1}.  The\ninhabitants are peacefully working in the surrounding fields.\nThey wave to you {happily}.
zh_hant: 探險隊抵達了一座%STRING0，屬於{%STRING1}。居民正在周圍田野間和平地耕作，並{開心地}向你們揮手。

source_en:
Your expedition has reached a %STRING0 of {%STRING1}.  The
inhabitants are busy
in the surrounding fields.  As they wave to you {happily},
you notice a collection of scalps hanging threateningly from
a nearby tree.
zh_hant: 探險隊抵達了一座%STRING0，屬於{%STRING1}。居民正忙碌地在周圍田野間工作。當他們{開心地}向你們揮手時，你們注意到附近一棵樹上，威嚇似地掛著一串頭皮。

source_en:
Your expedition has reached a %STRING0 of {%STRING1}.  The
inhabitants are busy in the surrounding fields.
Small parties of warriors practice
{archery} and frown at you {suspiciously}.
zh_hant: 探險隊抵達了一座%STRING0，屬於{%STRING1}。居民正忙著在周圍田野間工作。一小隊戰士正在練習{弓術}，並{狐疑地}對你們皺眉。

source_en: Your expedition has reached a %STRING0 of {%STRING1}.  A\nband of {warriors} eyes you warily.  The others\nare nowhere to be seen.

The {%STRING0} see that your food stores are low this
season.  Our own harvest has been plentiful, however,

everlasting peace between our peoples.  Let us eat together

「{%STRING0}見貴方今年的糧食存量偏低，

以紀念我們兩族之間永恆的和平。讓我們一同用餐，

source_en:
The {%STRING0} tribe is pleased to see the progress of
our neighbors at {%STRING1}.  We have come to offer you
{%NUMBER0 %STRING2} in recognition of the everlasting
peace between our peoples.

「{%STRING0}部落樂見鄰居
{%STRING1}的發展。我們特地前來獻上
{%NUMBER0 %STRING2}，

{%STRING0}樂見鄰居

time of need?

「{%STRING0}部落遭逢困境，這一季的

%STRING0 %STRING1.  We are most pleased at the amount

zh_hant: 大陸議會簽署{獨立宣言}！羅列種種暴政與僭越之舉！向國王遞交最後通牒！遠征軍出動鎮壓反叛！%STRING0將軍號召志願軍，組建新的大陸正規軍！
皇家遠征軍在{%STRING0}附近登陸！

source_en: Only {%NUMBER0%%} of the colonists support the independence\nmovement, Your Excellency.  We cannot start a rebellion against\nthe King until the {majority} is behind us.
zh_hant: 只有{%NUMBER0%%}的殖民地居民支持獨立運動，閣下。在獲得{過半數}支持之前，我們無法對國王發動反叛。

source_en:
Shall we declare our independence from {%STRING0}, Your Excellency?
This will end our turn and place us at war with our King!

"Never! That would be treasonous! God save the King!"
"Yes! Give me liberty or give me death!"
zh_hant:
閣下，我們要宣布脫離{%STRING0}獨立嗎？此舉將結束本回合，並使我們與國王開戰！

「不可！那是叛國之舉！天佑吾王！」
「好！不自由，毋寧死！」

source_en: Indian {converts} lose faith and return to tribe.  Converts\nwho do not join colonies within {eight turns} of their conversion\nare eliminated for loss of faith.
zh_hant: 印地安{歸順者}若未在皈依後的{八回合}內加入殖民領地，就會喪失信仰，返回部落，形同被淘汰出局。
notes: 目標159；converts沿用terms.zh-Hant.tsv定稿詞Indian Convert＝印地安歸順者（與help-bilingual.tsv TUTORIAL20舊譯稿「歸化者」不同，本詞優先採定稿術語表）；原文兩句合併為一句，語意不變。；不換：Indian converts 以「印地安歸順者」定稿為準

source_en: A {unit} cannot be created because the maximum number of units for\nthe game has been reached.  Units must be eliminated before new\nunits can be created.
zh_hant: 由於本局遊戲的單位數量已達上限，無法建立新{單位}。必須先淘汰現有單位，才能建立新單位。

source_en: A {colony} cannot be created because the maximum number of colonies for\nthe game has been reached.  Colonies must be eliminated before new\ncolonies can be created.
zh_hant: 由於本局遊戲的殖民領地數量已達上限，無法建立新{殖民領地}。必須先淘汰現有殖民領地，才能建立新的殖民領地。

source_en: Your Excellency, we cannot afford to pay the upkeep ({%NUMBER0$}) on\nall our buildings this turn.  Until we pay the {upkeep}, colonists in\nthe buildings will produce at {half efficiency}.
zh_hant: 閣下，我方本回合無法支付所有建築的維護費（{%NUMBER0$}）。在繳清{維護費}之前，這些建築內的殖民地居民將只以{效率減半}的狀態生產。

source_en: Continental Army mobilizes at {%STRING0}! Our Veteran %STRING1\nhave been promoted to {Continental Army} status.
zh_hant: 大陸正規軍已在{%STRING0}動員！我方老手%STRING1已晉升為{大陸正規軍}狀態。

source_en: Continental Army mobilizes at {%STRING0}! {%NUMBER0} Veteran\nunits have been promoted to {Continental Army} status.
zh_hant: 大陸正規軍已在{%STRING0}動員！{%NUMBER0}支老手部隊已晉升為{大陸正規軍}狀態。

source_en:
Continental Army can mobilize in colonies
which contain at least {%NUMBER0 muskets} only.  None
of our colonies have enough muskets available
for mobilization!
zh_hant: 大陸正規軍只能在至少擁有{%NUMBER0支火槍}的殖民領地動員。目前沒有一座殖民領地擁有足夠的火槍可供動員！
notes: 目標159；muskets依terms.zh-Hant.tsv變體「火槍」，配合中文量詞「支」。

source_en: Parliament votes additional funds to suppress\nrevolution in %STRING0.  {%STRING1} mobilized in %STRING2.
zh_hant: 英國國會撥出額外經費，鎮壓%STRING0的革命。{%STRING1}已在%STRING2動員。
notes: 目標159；Parliament非terms.zh-Hant.tsv定稿詞，glossary.zh-Hant.tsv列「議會，議會制度」；為與{大陸議會}（Continental Congress）區隔，譯為「英國國會」。

source_en:
The European Status Screen is no longer available once
the {War of Independence} has begun.  Ships cannot sail to
Europe for the duration of the war.  Colonies which build
{Custom House} improvements can trade with European smugglers,
however.
zh_hant: 一旦{獨立戰爭}開始，歐洲狀態畫面就不再提供，戰爭期間船隻也無法航向歐洲。不過，已興建{海關}的殖民領地仍可與歐洲走私商交易。

source_en: The Foreign Affairs Adviser's report is no longer available\nonce the {War of Independence} has begun.
zh_hant: 一旦{獨立戰爭}開始，外國事務顧問的報告就不再提供。
notes: 目標159；Foreign Affairs Adviser比照glossary.zh-Hant.tsv「Foreign Affairs Advisor＝外國事務顧問」。

source_en: Ships cannot sail to and from Europe for the duration\nof the {War of Independence}.  Colonies which build {Custom House}\nimprovements can trade with European smugglers, however.
zh_hant: {獨立戰爭}期間，船隻無法往返歐洲；不過，已興建{海關}的殖民領地仍可與歐洲走私商交易。

source_en: Foreign colonies cannot be attacked during the {War of Independence}.
zh_hant: {獨立戰爭}期間，無法攻擊外國殖民領地。

source_en: New colonies cannot be founded during the {War of Independence}.
zh_hant: {獨立戰爭}期間，無法建立新的殖民領地。

source_en: Scouts cannot meet with mayors during the {War of Independence}.
zh_hant: {獨立戰爭}期間，斥候無法與市長會面。
notes: 目標159；Mayor比照glossary.zh-Hant.tsv與batch-07.done.json先例，非定稿詞，字面譯為「市長」，指敵對歐洲殖民領地首長，非印地安人{酋長}。

source_en: You have brought nothing with you to trade with us.  Please come\nback when you have something useful to offer.
zh_hant: 「你沒有帶任何東西來跟我們交易。等你有實用的東西可以提供時再回來吧。」

source_en: We are not interested in your {%NUMBER0 %STRING0}.  Come back when\nyou have something better to offer.
zh_hant: 「我們對你的{%NUMBER0份%STRING0}沒有興趣。等你有更好的東西可以提供時再回來吧。」

source_en:
We will give you {%NUMBER0 %STRING0} in exchange for your %NUMBER1 %STRING1.
Or, if you like, we are willing to give you {%NUMBER2$}.
Is this satisfactory?

"We'll take the {%NUMBER0 %STRING0}."
"Just give us the {%NUMBER2$}."
"Do you take us for fools?"
zh_hant:
「我們願意用{%NUMBER0份%STRING0}向你交換%NUMBER1份%STRING1。或者，如果你願意，我們也可以給你{%NUMBER2$}。這樣你滿意嗎？」

「我們就收下{%NUMBER0份%STRING0}吧。」
「直接給我們{%NUMBER2$}就好。」
「你當我們是傻瓜嗎？」

source_en: The %STRING0 tribe has been wiped out.

The King of %STRING0 has offered to send us a force of trained {mercenaries}
(%STRING1)
in exchange for {%NUMBER0$}.

No thank you.
Pay {%NUMBER0$}.
zh_hant:
%STRING0國王提議派遣一支訓練有素的{外籍傭兵}部隊
（%STRING1）
前來助陣，交換條件是{%NUMBER0$}。

不用了，謝謝。
支付{%NUMBER0$}。

source_en: What cargo shall we throw overboard, Your Excellency?
zh_hant: 閣下，我們該把哪些貨物拋下船？

source_en: We are already fighting a War of Independence, Excellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們已經在打獨立戰爭了。

source_en: Population increase in %STRING0.  New colonist now available.
zh_hant: %STRING0人口增加，新殖民地居民已可運用。

source_en:
{%STRING0} has an inefficient government, Your Excellency!
Any colony which has {%NUMBER0} or more colonists who are
not members of the Sons of Liberty is lagging behind in its
governmental development.  Colonists in such colonies receive
a {-1} production penalty for every %NUMBER0 tories.  We can
increase Sons of Liberty membership by producing more {Liberty
Bells} in this colony; conversely, we can avoid the production
penalty by removing enough colonists to get the number of tories
below %NUMBER0.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}的政府效率低落！殖民領地中，若有{%NUMBER0}名以上的殖民地居民不是自由子民，其政治發展就會落後。這類殖民領地的居民會受到{-1}的生產懲罰；保皇黨每滿%NUMBER0人就懲罰一次。我們可以在這座殖民領地生產更多{自由鐘}，藉此增加自由子民人數；也可以把保皇黨人數降到%NUMBER0以下，來免除生產懲罰。

source_en: {%STRING0} has improved the efficiency of its government, Your Excellency.\nProduction penalties no longer apply to %STRING0 colonists.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}已提升其政府效率。%STRING0的殖民地居民不再受到生產懲罰。

source_en: Pioneers clear forest near {%STRING0}.  {%NUMBER0 lumber} added\nto stockpile.
zh_hant: 前鋒在{%STRING0}附近清除森林，{%NUMBER0份木材}已納入庫存。

source_en: The {%STRING0} tribe is ready to go on the warpath.\nWhom would you like us to attack?
zh_hant: 「{%STRING0}部落已準備好走上戰爭之路，您想要我們攻擊誰？」

source_en:
We will gladly drive the {%STRING0} from our ancestral
lands in exchange for {%NUMBER0$}.

Pay {%NUMBER0$}.
Never mind.
zh_hant:
「我們很樂意把{%STRING0}人趕出我們的祖傳土地，只要你付{%NUMBER0$}。」

支付{%NUMBER0$}。
算了。

source_en: {%STRING0} nation holds War Council!\n{%STRING1} missionaries incite %STRING2 to warfare against\nthe {%STRING3}!
zh_hant: {%STRING0}部落召開戰爭會議！{%STRING1}的傳教士煽動%STRING2對{%STRING3}開戰！
notes: 目標159；「nation」依War Council機制脈絡譯為部落；假設%STRING0與%STRING2為同一部落，%STRING3為遭挑起戰事的對象。

source_en: %STRING0 %STRING1.  Our efforts in the New World have\nproven fruitless and we have decided to remove you\nas Viceroy.  You may, as always, kiss our royal pinky ring.
zh_hant: 「%STRING0 %STRING1。我們在新大陸的努力已經徒勞無功，因此決定撤除你副王的職位。一如既往，你儘管去親吻我們尊貴的戒指吧。」
notes: 目標159；Viceroy沿用corpus既有譯法「副王」（見batch-01 @VICEROY）；kiss our royal pinky ring為輕蔑修辭，譯文保留語氣但簡化「小指戒指」為「戒指」。

source_en: %STRING0 %STRING1 plans to retire in 1800!  A rumor circulates\nthat he would postpone his retirement were a War of Independence\nto begin.
zh_hant: %STRING0 %STRING1計畫在1800年退休！謠傳如果獨立戰爭爆發，他就會延後退休。
notes: 目標159；不換：a rumor circulates 譯謠傳

source_en: General %STRING1, the people are weary of this long war.  If we cannot\nforce a conclusion by 1850, the Continental Congress will sue for\npeace and seek to swear renewed allegiance to the King.
zh_hant: 「%STRING1將軍，人民已經厭倦了這場漫長的戰爭。如果我們無法在1850年前分出勝負，大陸議會就會求和，設法向國王重新宣誓效忠。」

source_en: %STRING0 %STRING1 steps down after over 300 years of loyal service to the\nCrown.  King knights aging Viceroy, who retires to country estate\nnear %STRING2.
zh_hant: %STRING0 %STRING1在為皇城效忠超過三百年後卸任。國王將這位年邁的副王封為爵士，讓他退休隱居到%STRING2附近的鄉間莊園。

source_en: War-weary Continental Congress sues for peace!  King accepts\nsurrender from %STRING0 %STRING1, who retires to country\nestate near %STRING2.
zh_hant: 厭戰的大陸議會求和！國王接受%STRING0 %STRING1的投降，此後他退休隱居到%STRING2附近的鄉間莊園。

source_en:
We have just won a glorious victory on the road to freedom, Your Excellency.
In order to
defeat the King's forces and win our independence, we must recapture
{all} of our colonies from the King, and we must destroy most of his
ground forces in the New World.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們剛在通往自由的道路上贏得了一場光榮的勝利。要擊敗國王的軍隊、贏得獨立，我們必須從國王手中奪回{全部}殖民領地，還必須摧毀他在新大陸的大部分地面部隊。
%STRING0 %STRING1{受損}。再受到損傷就會被摧毀。

source_en:
^^Colonization Help: Time Scale
^
In 1600, the {time scale} changes from one turn per year to
{two turns per year}.  Henceforth there will be a {Spring} and
a {Fall} turn in each year.
zh_hant: ^^殖民帝國說明：時間尺度\n^\n1600年時，{時間尺度}會從每年一回合改為{每年兩回合}。此後每年將分為{春季}與{秋季}兩個回合。
notes: 目標159；「Colonization Help: <主題>」為說明頁重複出現的標題樣板，本批次尚無先例可循，暫譯「殖民帝國說明：<主題>」，待其他批次一併核對是否統一。

source_en: Indian converts already know the Indian ways.
zh_hant: 印地安歸順者早已熟悉印地安人的生活方式。

source_en: Some of the cargo could not be unloaded because of a parliamentary\nboycott.  If you want to ask that the boycott be lifted, click on\nthe cargo type in question.
zh_hant: 部分貨物因國會的杯葛而無法卸下。如果你想要求解除杯葛，請點選相關的貨物種類。

source_en: We cannot voluntarily reduce below {three} the population of a colony\nthat has a stockade, fort, or fortress.
zh_hant: 設有柵欄、堡壘或碉堡的殖民領地，人口不能主動減少到{三}人以下。

source_en: We cannot put more than {three} colonists in any one building, Your\nExcellency.
zh_hant: 閣下，任何一棟建築物最多只能容納{三}位殖民地居民。

source_en:
None of the spaces surrounding this square are forested, Your Excellency.
A colony built here will have a hard time getting enough lumber to supply
its carpenters.

Cancel action.
Build colony anyway.
zh_hant:
閣下，這個方格周圍沒有森林地形，在這裡建立殖民領地將難以取得足夠的木材供應木匠使用。

取消動作。
仍然建立殖民領地。

source_en:
There are only a few productive squares adjacent to this square,
Your Excellency.  A colony built here may have a lower potential
for growth than we hope.  Perhaps we should move on to a larger
area?

Cancel action.
Build colony anyway.
zh_hant:
閣下，這個方格周圍能生產資源的方格不多，在此建立殖民領地成長潛力恐怕不如預期。我們是否該另尋一片更廣闊的地區？

取消動作。
仍然建立殖民領地。

source_en:
In our wisdom, we have decided to let you go
your own way. We have far more importatnt
matters to deal with than you wretched
colonists. Do not seek our aid in the future,
for it will not be forthcoming.
zh_hant: 「憑我們的睿智，決定讓你自行其是。我們有比你們這些卑微的殖民地居民更重要的事務要處理。往後不必再向我們求援，因為不會再有任何援助。」

source_en:
As expected, your attempt to separate from
mother %STRING0 has proven futile. Your
Rag Tag armies are simply no match for our
Royal forces.
zh_hant: 「不出所料，你們想脫離母國%STRING0的企圖終究是白費力氣。你們那烏合之眾的軍隊，根本不是我們皇家軍隊的對手。」

source_en: We cannot disband a ship at sea while it is carrying\nunits.
zh_hant: 船隻在海上載運單位時，不能解散。

source_en: {%STRING0} is set to produce a {Warehouse Expansion},\nYour Excellency, but only {one} expansion is allowed\nper colony.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}已設定要建造{倉庫擴建}，但每座殖民領地只能有{一}次擴建。

source_en: {%STRING0} is set to produce a {Wagon Train}, Your\nExcellency, but we are not allowed to have more\nwagon trains than we have colonies ({%NUMBER0}).
zh_hant: 閣下，{%STRING0}已設定要建造{貨車}，但貨車數量不能超過我們擁有的殖民領地數（{%NUMBER0}）。

^{INDIAN CONVERTS}
Missionaries working among the native population are able to convince 
some of the Indians of the veracity of Christianity. These converts are 
good outdoorsmen -- good at all the outdoor professions. However, they 
are not well suited to manufacturing or processing jobs.
zh_hant: ^{印地安歸順者}\n在原住民之間傳教的傳教士，能讓部分印地安人相信基督教義而皈依。這些歸順者精於各種戶外工作，但不適合擔任製造或加工類職務。
notes: 目標159；不換：native population 指原住民群體
